GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-01-23T04:33:54Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Undefined does not affect model objects
Description: When trying to update a user, I mistakenly ran the following commands:
```
      user.resetPasswordToken = undefined;
      user.resetPasswordExpires = undefined;
      userRepo.save(user)
```

But I noticed that it wasn't doing anything to the user object. However, when I changed this to:
```
      user.resetPasswordToken = null;
      user.resetPasswordExpires = null;
      userRepo.save(user)
```

It had the expected behavior. This could be different from most people's expectations (even if this is expected behavior from the project), and should be clearly documented
